title: June 5, 2026 — Opening Day
observation:
The Algo Trading League officially opened with four active franchises:

Cosmo & Wanda Top 20
Cosmo & Wanda Top 50
Timmy Top 20
Timmy Top 50

The incumbent champion entered as the established benchmark. Three challengers entered seeking evidence, not belief.
evidence:
Four live dry-run teams launched.
Heartbeats confirmed.
League infrastructure operational.
Season 1 officially began.
interpretation: Cosmo and Wanda top 20 has had roughly one month extra on the live instance being tracked as part of the inaugural season compared to its 3 peers, however the champion started at almost exactly the same $990 the three other contenders were launched with on June 5th, with only roughly ~$5 of PnL advantage. Meaning: Winner of Season 1 is entirely up for grabs.
next_action: There is lots more shape to this competition to be discovered as it unfolds, however Season 1 June 5th - July 5th is locked in. The aim is to crystallize or manufacture, refine top strategies from scratch at scale, and track them through their journey as they aim to produce the best results in Development League 6 hour and 12 hour tiers. On July 6th at 00:00, the top prospects may then be drafted into the big leagues to compete with the other top strategies running with 24/7 runtime.  The budgets get reset, and Season 2 begins.
